messages:
Ravi (New Hire): hi folks, quick q in my first day: who do i ping to get SSO access to internal repos, and who handles provisioning of a demo GCP project for experiments?
Maya (People Ops): welcome Ravi! :tada: People Ops triggers SSO invites, but eng-infra owns project provisioning. i'll start the SSO invite now.
Lena (Eng-Infra): yup, eng-infra for projects/quotas/VPC peering. ping me with your github email and desired project name. we try to provision sandbox projects within a day.
Ravi (New Hire): thanks — github email is ravi.kumar@github.com and i'd like project name `ravi-sandbox-1`. also, are there allowlists i need to add for local testing?
Omar (Eng): for hosted runtime testing you might need org token and IP allowlist for egress. eng-infra can add an allowlist entry; eng-platform manages token scopes.
Nina (Platform): Platform handles token policies and route permissions. tell us which endpoints you're calling and we'll confirm required scopes. usually `inference:invoke` is enough.
Tariq (Eng-SRE): if the provisioning blocks critical onboarding work, page eng-infra first, then eng-sre if it's a cross-team outage. file a ticket with `first-week` tag for faster handling outside business hours.
Oncall Bot: Eng-Infra oncall: Lena (primary), Alex (secondary). Shift: 2026-03-24 07:00 - 2026-03-25 07:00 UTC.
Ravi (New Hire): thanks everyone — Maya, did the SSO invite go out?
Maya (People Ops): invite sent to ravi.kumar@company.email, check spam and accept link. once accepted i'll add you to #dev-new-hires and the pairing session at 14:00 PT.
Lena (Eng-Infra): provisioning started for `ravi-sandbox-1`. i'll add a temporary allowlist for your home IP (please DM it to me) and grant project viewer + service account oncall role for testing.
Ravi (New Hire): DMing IP now. appreciate the help! i'll join the pairing session later. closing if nothing else.
Maya (People Ops): will follow up on checklist items and owners map. welcome again!
